clippings.speaker: Ron Clements
clippings.quote: We knew the score because we had heard it a lot even when we were working on Mermaid.
clippings.title: Aladdin Cast and Directors Divulge New Details About the Disney Movie and Reflect on Robin Williams' Performance
clippings.context: Clements on the Aladdin score that he and Musker inherited from the Ashman and Menken songs they had worked with on The Little Mermaid; the score is by Menken and Tim Rice.

notes: Thin pair: only one quote verified verbatim. Blocked or unusable: ew.com (fetch refused), Golden Globes Clements piece (404), Billboard and Variety, St. Louis Today and Sioux City Journal (redirected to paywall service, skipped). uDiscover Music quotes Menken on the 2015 Entertainment Weekly Hercules interview ('The directors, Ron Clements and John Musker, really wanted gospel...') but the full sentence was not retrievable verbatim, so it is not used.
